workspace.description: The workspace, by the slug list_workspaces answered, whose skills to list or whose GitHub installation reads a source; leave it out where the member belongs to one workspace alone.

source.description: What to install from, as the member would paste it into Add skill: a GitHub repository (owner/name or its address), a link to one of its folders, an `npx skills add` line naming one, or a skill's own SKILL.md text.

scope.description: Whose the skills are: personal, the member's alone in every workspace they belong to; or workspace, offered to the agents of every member of the workspace, never in the member's personal workspace.

skills.description: From a GitHub source, the skills to install by name, as preview_skill_install listed them; at least one.

sha.description: From a GitHub source, the commit preview_skill_install answered, so the files installed are the ones the member was shown.

name.description: For a skill's text, the name to install it by; its frontmatter's where left out.

description.description: For a skill's text, the summary to install it by, which tells agents when to use it; its frontmatter's where left out.
